href.description: Unique href for this notification log event, which can be used for event lookup via the events API

event.description: Correlation href identifying the API request / context from which events originated

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which this event was originally created

pce_fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name of the PCE, where this event originated

created_by.description: The entity responsible for the creation of this event

user.description: The user responsible for the creation of this event

agent.description: The agent responsible for the creation of this event

notification_type.description: Notification name that clearly describes the notification log event

info.description: Extra information about the notification in json format
